0022600166.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 0-2 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-3, 2-1 at home), with Milwaukee sitting 14th in the East and Minnesota 10th in the West. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Milwaukee has no players unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in the 2025-26 season series the Bucks lost 0-2, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
